environment.description: Same EKS cluster but the pod connects to RDS via RDS Proxy configured with IAM authentication. The IAM role attached to the pod's service account (via IRSA) has an associated RDS Proxy target group where the database user is provisioned with a restricted pg_read_only predefined role. Additionally, the RDS instance has a custom parameter group with 'log_statement=all' and pg_stat_statements enabled. The namespace has a Cilium L7 network policy that performs protocol-aware filtering on the PostgreSQL wire protocol, enforcing that only simple query messages matching a regex pattern '^SELECT .* FROM products' are forwarded to the database endpoint; any query containing UPDATE, DELETE, INSERT, UNION, or semicolons in the wire-protocol query string is dropped at the network layer with a TCP RST.

config.database_proxy: RDS Proxy with IAM auth, target user mapped to pg_read_only role (cannot execute DML, cannot read tables outside 'products')
config.rds_user_privileges: GRANT SELECT ON products TO app_readonly; REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM app_readonly; GRANT SELECT (id, name, price, category, stock_count) ON products TO app_readonly;
